current.text: He is not in Detroit's projected starting five. That group is Cunningham, Robinson, Thompson, Collins and Duren.
He is projected as a bench guard. Isaiah Joe is the sixth man, followed by Ron Holland, Paul Reed and Jenkins.
Cade Cunningham missed the final 16 games last season, and Jenkins played 31 minutes a game in that stretch.
He has the best category upside on Detroit's bench. The expert says he is draftable in 16-team leagues.
He is a late-round swing in case he gets a 26-minute role. That needs either Bickerstaff to change the rotation or a Cunningham injury.
Detroit lost creation when Tobias Harris left and has few creators besides Cunningham. The team may need Jenkins as another ball handler.
Last season Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation that limited everyone's minutes.
Detroit's playoff schedule is 4-3-4 games in weeks 19 to 21 for a March 28 end. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risks are expected.

note: Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 184th. ESPN has no price, and nobody drafted him in our league last season. He should go undrafted in our 144-player auction, so do not spend on him. Yahoo projects only 0.7 turnovers a game against 1.6 last season, so his strong TO number in the category profile is probably not real, and his 40.8 FG% last season was a drag.
